title: Flow screens: a flat `screen` has no `file` field type, so a multi-step wizard must create the record before its last step to collect a file — and closing the screen dialog leaves the run paused and the half-written record behind
body:
Blocked-by: #25692

Filing class: ③ capability gap, filed at destination by the hotclm director seat under the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotclm#99 item 4 (batch 5, letter B, 2026-10-25). Unlabelled, no assignee; the objectstack seat triages.

## Symptom (hotclm, `@objectstack/*` 18.1.0 and 17.7.0)

hotclm's intake wizard (F1, `contract-intake.flow.ts`) asks three screens of questions and then needs the first version file for a contract type that carries no template. A flat `screen` node cannot collect a file, so the flow creates the `clm_contract` at `create_contract` and then opens an **object-form** screen on `clm_contract_version` (whose required `contract` lookup must point at an existing row) to upload it. A requester who closes the dialog at that point leaves a version-less draft behind (NDA-2026-0021 in the browser pass) that they cannot delete (`DELETE` → 403; the app grants requesters RCU). Reordering the flow cannot fix it: the write has to precede the only widget that can take the file.

## What the platform does today (read on main, 2026-10-25)

- `ScreenFieldConfigSchema.type` is an open string (`packages/spec/src/automation/builtin-node-config.zod.ts:897`), but the console's flat-screen renderer (`objectui packages/app-shell/src/views/ScreenView.tsx:356-421`) handles `lookup` (with `reference`), `boolean`/`checkbox`, `textarea`/`markdown`, and maps `number`/`currency`/`email`/`date` to an `<input>`; everything else falls to a text input. There is no file control, and `resume` has no file-bag contract.
- Closing the screen dialog sends no request: `FlowRunner.tsx:624` `onOpenChange` calls `onClose` only; `cancelRun` is never called, so the run stays `paused` and whatever the flow wrote before the screen stays written.

Seat analysis with the measurement: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotclm/issues/99#issuecomment-6392858419.

## Expected capability

1. A `type: 'file'` screen field on a flat screen: the console renders the platform file widget, the file is stored through the normal file service, and `resume` receives a file reference the next node can write into a `file` field (hotclm would write it into `clm_contract_version.file`).
2. Closing a paused run's screen dialog cancels the run (or offers to), so a wizard that is authored "ask everything, write at the end" leaves nothing behind when abandoned.

With (1) the app can move every write after the last screen, per its design; (2) closes the remaining abandonment path for flows that must write mid-way.

## Dedupe

Searched objectstack issues for flow screen file upload field / flat screen cannot collect a file / cancel run on dialog close: no card asks for a file-typed screen field or for cancel-on-close.
